correctness.rationale: The parent-forest encoding and inverse breadth-first plane-tree mapping are consistent with monotone regressive maps. Nonfixed members of im(f^k) are exactly vertices with depth-k descendants; fixed roots contribute at most s. Exact fixed-count Catalan coefficients give a tight root count (limiting distribution s/2^(s+1)). A uniform n-edge plane tree is a conditioned critical Galton-Watson tree with geometric(1/2) offspring. Janson empirical-fringe theorem applies to bounded fixed-k height indicator. Survival satisfies q_(k+1)=q_k/(1+q_k), q_k=1/(k+1). Dividing by n, removing root correction, and using 0<=rank/n<=1 gives L2; finite joint convergence follows componentwise. This proves only fixed exponents. Independently generated maps reproduce exact ranks at n=3,5,8.
